interventions.detail: pypdfium2==4.30.0: 5.x removed PdfDocument.render, so page rasterization fails and no output is produced
used a Python 3.10 uv venv instead of the system Python 3.12 (supported versions only go up to 3.10)
installed CPU-only torch 2.2.2/torchvision 0.17.2 from the PyTorch CPU index
pinned numpy<2, lightning==2.2.5, albumentations==1.3.1, transformers==4.38.2, setuptools<81 so they work with timm 0.5.4
pre-downloaded the 0.1.0-small checkpoint and the nltk 'words' corpus in setup
